dct_description_sm:
There are two economic files: D2ECO001 and D2ECO002.

The D2ECO001 file contains data on Table 1: Detailed occupations (500) by detailed industries (269) by class of worker (9) by sex (3) for the experienced and employed labour force at the Canada and province levels.

The D2ECO002 file contains data on Table 1: Detailed occupations (500) by sex (3) by single years of age, 5-year age groups, 10-year age groups at the Canada and province levels.
